adjudication.rationale: The diff adds Admin::EmbeddableHostsController#update and #destroy that do `host = EmbeddableHost.where(id: params[:id]).first` and then unconditionally call `save_host(host)` (which does `host.host = ...`) or `host.destroy`. If the ID is unknown, `host` will be nil and these lines will raise NoMethodError, yielding a 500 instead of a controlled 404/422 response. The referenced spec indeed only asserts inheritance and does not exercise these code paths, but independently of test coverage the nil-handling in the new CRUD endpoints is a concrete defect visible in the diff.
